result:
If I could change one thing, I’d make **critical empathy** universal and instinctive: the ability to genuinely understand another person’s experience while still thinking clearly and independently.

Most of the world’s worst problems—war, oppression, exploitation, neglect—depend on some form of distance or dehumanization. People can only tolerate immense suffering when they don’t truly see the people affected as real, complex, and worthy of care. If that distance collapsed, it wouldn’t magically solve every disagreement or resource problem, but it would radically change what people are willing to accept and how they treat one another.

It wouldn’t make everyone agree. It would just make it much harder to be cruel.
